scientific_hypothesis: Analytically removing the Gaussian marginal component of the linear-path conditional-flow velocity reduces nuisance regression and small-scale sample noise without changing the target law, conditioning, architecture, loss on reconstructed velocity, or optimizer-step budget.
execution_only_dataloader_contract: num_workers_train=num_workers_val=0 avoids multiprocessing shared-memory queues; a post-Accelerate RNG compatibility adapter suppresses only the extra per-iterator CPU base-seed draws after each loader's first iterator, reproducing persistent-worker shuffle order while leaving the frozen dataset, optimizer updates, and target law unchanged

pretraining_solver_control.completed_control_finding: The bf16 RK4-64 versus RK4-128 comparison converged, but bf16 versus strict FP32 exceeded the frozen 1 percent relative-score threshold (maximum 1.5569274 percent). Event-probability and SIC-neighbor-energy thresholds passed. Fixed panels remained strongly granular for every solver and precision variant, so the tested numerical effects do not explain the raw-checkpoint sample failure.
pretraining_solver_control.required_refinement: Strict-FP32 RK4-64 versus RK4-128 on the same two cases, two member seeds and initial noise as the completed control.
pretraining_solver_control.decision: Pilot is permitted only when the new hash-bound strict-FP32 refinement gate is converged: every per-field/per-lead fair-CRPS and mean-RMSE relative change is at most 1 percent, every mean occurrence/cap probability change is at most 1 percentage point, and every per-lead SIC neighbor-energy relative change is at most 1 percent for strict-FP32 RK4-64 versus RK4-128. A pass freezes strict FP32 as the common raw/candidate evaluation backend; the failed predecessor gate remains part of the record and its threshold is not relaxed.

evaluation.seasonal_rule: two fixed eligible validation dates from each meteorological season
evaluation.solver_stability_gate: aggregate physical scores change by at most 1 percent and event probabilities by at most 1 percentage point from 64 to 128 RK4 intervals

candidate_solver_refinement.reuse: the exact paired-pilot initial noise tensors already generated for these case/member positions
candidate_solver_refinement.comparison: strict-FP32 RK4-64 versus RK4-128 with the frozen solver thresholds

evaluation.spatial_gate: for each field separately, lag-1/2/4 variogram error decreases by at least 30 percent relative to the paired raw-velocity epoch-15 reference; SIC and SIT are never pooled across physical units; no temporal-increment regression
evaluation.proper_score_gate: fieldwise per-lead fair CRPS and ensemble-mean RMSE do not degrade by more than 2 percent
evaluation.calibration_gate: fieldwise per-lead rank-TV to uniform and mean absolute central 50/80/90 coverage error do not regress relative to the paired raw-velocity reference
evaluation.visual_gate: fixed paired SIC/SIT member panels show no salt-and-pepper, track imprint, or disconnected granular texture

failure_interpretation: A failed paired pilot does not support Gaussian-path velocity preconditioning at the tested 2128-step budget; it does not justify smoothing, seed selection, clipping, or opening test-2023.
